items.item: K3, the condition read in time (In brief and Human development, both languages)
items.how: In brief: 'Read in time, it cannot hold over every step, since nothing reaches back; read from some step on, it holds exactly where, from any formation at any step, every formation is reached at some later step, through exchanges and each one's going on (proved on models, 07 §4.11)', the fronts' short form, word for word as the first screen now has it. Human development: the in-time clause moved to its own Proved line in the same words ('Read in time, the condition cannot hold over every step ...'), since the joined line counted 111 prose words against the 90 a line may have. Chinese, both places: K3's short form verbatim (按时间来读，它不能在每一步都成立，因为没有什么能到达过去；若从某一步起来读，它恰在这样的地方成立：从任一步的任一形成出发，经由交换与各自的延续，每一个形成都会在此后某一步被到达), the Human development line opening 按时间来读，延续条件不能在每一步都成立. 'over what comes after' (the stronger form) is joined to none of these; it stays only in the one-center line, where it names «续无外于后».

items.item: K4, the direction's hypotheses (People and AI, Conditional; the handover case)
items.how: USES: 'offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence to actual systems; its theorems take J1/J2 and compare moves by what their outcomes admit, and do not use the condition; read under it, every admission compared counts from every standpoint; for actual AI systems, argued (07 §7)', as 07 §7's lead and the overview now say it. USES.zh: 这一方向以延续条件、J1–J4 以及与实际系统的对应为前提；其定理取 J1/J2，按各动作的结果所容纳者来比较诸动作，不使用延续条件；在该条件之下来读，所比较的每一项容纳从每一个立场看都算数 (the one page's and overview's Chinese, astra's sentence with 的 and 诸动作). USES-EXAMPLES' handover line: 'offered under the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence; its rankings take J1/J2 and compare plans by what they admit, without using the condition', zh to match; and 'The case's verdicts take J1/J2' → 'The case's rankings take J1/J2' (这一情形的裁断 → 排序), the eighth pass's verifier's low item: J3's and J4's lines are verdicts too, and `Requirement.Handover.direction` checks only the rankings.

items.item: K8, the aim as AGENTS.md states it (USES's opening paragraph; People and AI)
items.how: Opening: 'From this map we want to design an alignment of the joint selection, people, institutions and trained systems selecting together, that keeps it out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor: a joint selection that reads beyond its own share and does not come to select for control over its own selection (the goal)', word for word as the first screen and MAP now say it. AJ's condition-1 wording left the opening and People and AI's Do today (adding a label there would have taken the Do today line from 50 to 56 words, against its limit of 50), and now stands once, on the line that says where the three questions come from, labelled: 'The three questions rest on them, from AJ's plan, an AI-authored plan, and are asked so that a loss beyond the shapers' share can turn the rule, as the goal's first condition asks.' Chinese: 这样的联合选择读取自身份额之外的东西，也不会转而去选择对自身之选择的控制, the Chinese screen's wording with USES.zh's own word 联合选择 (the screen says 共同选择); the label 问这些问题，是为了如目标的第一个条件所要求的那样，让塑造者份额之外的损失能使规则转向. USES-EXAMPLES' checklist keeps AJ's three conditions, already labelled there as 'three conditions'.
